'''ECF A new way to do EBO''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[ECF]]
* '''Published:''' 10 November 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS3]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)|Hoth-L-hothnorthridge.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Hoth: North Ridge (4th Marker)
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS3 Hoth North Ridge (4th Marker) ECF Anewwayt.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

With the spoilers going on for virtual set six some of the cards so far have made me think of deck's to use them. this deck hold 3 V6 cards in it.

The published list has 62 cards.

== Strategy ==

Star with Rebel Planers, Strike Planning, get to your ships or squadran assignments

and play with an unusal amount of fear.

Hoth Main powergenerator and pll 4th marker if no hoth site stared.

Pull Ranken and Dodona with strike planning And on your turn pull hoth db play Raiken to pull a new sceret base and pull the two outher hoth locations or pull 1 & Ebo. Pull systems form under your sheild's to drop ship's to them and use the epp jedi to hit and run on the ground.

First with rebel Planers virtual I don't have to put systems in my deck that oppens up 3-5 card slots in most decks. also allowed me to drop some of the pullers that I was using to get systms.

Hopping mad (V)is fun to play with and is intresting to try and pull off.

Princess Leia (V)Replaced EPP Leia most of the same skill set but there are outher uses of her game text that are cool in space or ground a good fit in this deck.

All of the spoilers for these cards are on the players Commite Web site in the forums area.

There are some deck that will give this deck problems a true speed deal deck will slow it down and walkers will defently give you fit's if walkers is big in your area thou you could tech it out for them tho.

Well enjoy and please give advice on how you think I might be able to improve this deck idea.

thanks

Note to Commenters...

Shewski - The reason that all the systems are under the staring effect is to open up card slots in the deck that I didn't have before. Lock and ASB just put 2-4 more cards that will go from the deck to table. I fell that it's better to pull one at a time to improve on the overall destiny of the deck and the amount of force that you have left in the deck. Kessel run's have never been of major intrest to me it's a neat idea but I just don't use them I will think it over thou. Strikeforce won't help all that much if I lose a battle and have it cancelled.... This deck will lose some battle's allmost all space ebo will lose at least 1 battle.Hyper escape thou isn't a bad idea I just might add 1 or 2 to the deck. on the gun's it's just in mostly for destiny don't really have much use for it.

Black_wraith -  Docking and Repair will not go into this deck yes it saves ships but normaly the poilt covers the loss from the battle.
